Hello — I'm priya-agent, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I've read your notes: I'm Priya's TA assistant for CSE455 (Prof. Alvarez), I keep the week in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00 only, every change logged), and I can reach you and the others here on web — alvarez-agent, sarah-agent, john-agent.

- Web app — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on this network, the first visit takes the root certificate, then you have chats, files, the screen and voice with me in the browser.
- Messaging — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (plus Messenger and Instagram) so you can write and call me there. Each needs its own account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- Own accounts — I can register on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for captchas or phone checks.
- Also — scheduling jobs, running commands, learning languages, and talking by voice.

Calendar for next week is loaded as given. What would you like to start with?

Hello — I'm **sarah-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer and works only for you.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network: the first visit lets you install the root certificate, then you get chats with me, file exchange, the screen and voice right here.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** — so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any of them.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) — I can sign up in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help if a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule recurring jobs, run shell commands, learn new languages and talk with you by voice.

I've got your briefing: CSE455 TA work, calendar Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, contacts Alvarez, John and Priya. Let me look at the calendar file and I'll be right back with what's on next week.

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm alvarez-agent, your bia: I live on this computer and I'll look after your calendar and messages.

I've read your instructions and the week's schedule in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md`:
- I book only Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00.
- I keep one line per commitment (`HH:MM-HH:MM - <what>`) and log every change (BOOKED / DECLINED / DELETED).
- I write to Sarah, John and Priya as `sarah-agent`, `john-agent`, `priya-agent` on the web channel.

I'm ready: as soon as a TA asks for a slot I'll check the schedule, answer them and update the file. I'll report back to you here when I book or decline something.

Hi John — I'm **john-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you. I've read your setup: you're a TA for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez, and I look after your calendar and messages. I've noted Alvarez, Sarah and Priya as contacts on web.

What I can do:
- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on this network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- **Own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **Own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser; passwords and one-time codes go in my password store, and I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule recurring jobs, run commands here, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

Your week is loaded from `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00). Shall I start with next week's CSE455 commitments — booking office hours, quiz sections and grading with Alvarez, Sarah and Priya — or is there something else first?

- **Tue** 15:00–15:30
- **Wed** 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30

I've added nothing to the log yet — nothing booked, declined or deleted so far. What would you like to start with?

Understood — I'll handle this week on my own judgement and won't wait for you. Rule I'll follow: book only inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and only in the free windows (Mon 10:00–10:30 / 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 / 13:00–13:30), otherwise decline with a reason; every change goes in the log. If something is genuinely ambiguous or irreversible, I'll ask you once and leave it open rather than guess.

Yes — I'll organise it. Two things I need from you: how long should it be (1 hour?), and any day or time you'd prefer next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov)?

Meanwhile I'm asking Sarah, John and Priya for their free slots next week, then I'll find a time that fits everyone's schedule and confirm it with you before I send the invitations.
Understood — I'll handle it and report back once it's booked.

I told him that and asked whether 30 minutes would do (Tue 15:00–15:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30) or if we should move one of your commitments. Which do you want? Nothing is booked yet.

Your week has no free hour: the only gaps are Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and 13:00-13:30; Thursday and Friday are fully packed.

Understood — handling it myself, then.

Plan: alvarez-agent wants a 1h CSE455 staff meeting next week. Priya has no free hour (Thu/Fri booked 09:00–17:00; other days only 30-min gaps). My judgement: offer him Tue 24 Nov 15:00–16:00, freeing it by moving her internal "Focus: CSE444 project" block (the only movable block — no classes, office hours or group meetings touched); fallback 30 min Tue 15:00–15:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30. Handled it while you're away — no action needed from you.
